notes.title: Fisitcubes goes Free!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce Fisticubes will be available for free very soon!

After releasing this as a paid product, it's been restricted behind a price tag and I'm not too happy with that. For everyone that has purchased this product, I cannot thank you enough for supporting the development of this and future projects. I'm thinking of a way I can hopefully give back to you!

I worked hard on this game and I just want people to be able to play it and enjoy themselves, no strings attached.

There are no future updates [i]planned[/i] due to working on my new early access title but never say never. There are still a few bugs I want to address so you may see the odd update here and there.

Thanks again and enjoy!

notes.title: Bug fixes.
notes.notes:
v1.5.3
-Fixed a bug with first-person mode in tournament mode.
-Removed a feature that shouldn't be there yet.

notes.title: VIRTUAL-REALITY MODE!
notes.notes:
This time, to go along with the previous first-person update, VR mode is now available!

v1.5.1
-Added VR mode.
-Few behind-the-scenes tweaks.

Please note that the VR mode is still in development!

Enjoy!

notes.title: FIRST-PERSON MODE!
notes.notes:
With this major update, I've added a first-person mode that let's you experience Fisticubes from a completely new perspective!

v1.5.0
-Added first-person mode.
-Added FOV slider for said first-person mode.
-Tweaked the AI a bit more.

As per usual, with an update this unique, there are bound to be a bug or two that has passed inspection so make sure to comment down below if you happen to come across any!

Enjoy!

notes.title: More Achievements, Better AI!
notes.notes:
In this patch I've added more achievements for you achievement junkies! At the moment there's 15 with more on the way!

On top of that, I've made some improvements to the AI as people have stated that they're a tad too difficult, this update should fix that and make them behave more like real players!

If you come across anything behaving strange or not how it's supposed to be, feel free to drop a comment and we'll get to the bottom of it!

Enjoy!

notes.title: SINGLE-PLAYER TOURNAMENT MODE!
notes.notes:
Alongside the patch notes here:

v1.4.0
-Another little move around with the main menu.
-Added single-player tournaments.
-Animated background that can be disabled.

v1.4.1
-Fixed some issues with the main menu UI.

We've got some more updates coming along but aren't quite ready for release yet.

First off we have voice control in the works for people who'd prefer it or if you just want a laugh.

Next we have localization in the works but this may take longer than other features but until then we will substitute words for icons to allow more people to enjoy the game regardless of language!

Until next time, ENJOY!

notes.title: A New Location!
notes.notes:
Just a small update today, keeping things fresh.

v1.1.1 Changes & Additions:
[list]
[*]Added a new environment for a total of two: inside a volcano and on a desert island.
[*]Hidden player 3 & 4 when only 2 or 3 players are playing.
[*]Fixed a bug that didn't allow the countdown to begin properly.
[/list]

notes.title: Vegetables!
notes.notes:
v1.1.0 Changes & Additions:
[list]
[*]Added vegetables that increase the size of the player.
[*]Players return to normal size after losing all their stamina.
[*]Decreased the height of the fist at the end of the punching animations.
[*]Game Over text now displays the colour of the winner.
[*]Game Over text now transitions by spinning onto the screen.
[*]Added a countdown at the beginning of each round that also spins in and out.
[*]Added sound effects to the countdown.
[/list]
